purpose: Define the strict Stage1->Stage2->Stage3 certification path without Python compiler delegation and with exact fixed-point reproducibility.

artifact_construction.stage2: execute Stage1 compiler on exact canonical source -> assembly -> host assembler/linker -> ELF
artifact_construction.stage3: execute Stage2 compiler on same exact canonical source -> assembly -> identical host assembler/linker recipe -> ELF
artifact_construction.host_object: compile stage1_host_io.c exactly once and reuse the identical object for Stage2 and Stage3 linking

pythonless_compiler_runtime.strict_runtime_proof: strace -f execve trace shows exactly the compiler executable and no descendant execve
pythonless_compiler_runtime.strace_missing: blocks strict FULL_SELF_HOSTING certification rather than silently downgrading proof

determinism.optional_stage4: Stage3 may compile the same source to Stage4 as an additional fixed-point confirmation

fail_closed: stage1 certification report missing or inconsistent
Stage1 compiler emits nonzero status or diagnostics for canonical source
Stage2 compiler invokes any descendant process
Stage2 and Stage3 ELF bytes differ
